title: Design System: Señas a Voces Academy

display.purpose: Cover h1 only. Petroleum, with the second line set as a cyan block.

statement.purpose: The scroll-revealed manifesto and the closing quote on the band. Max 18 to 22ch.

headline.purpose: The h2 chapter title of each sheet. Petroleum on cream, max 760px.

subtitle.purpose: Creator names (clamp 28 to 36px), step titles (22px), device captions (24px), milestone labels (19px).

body-lead.purpose: Sheet intros under the headline. Muted, max 56ch.

body.purpose: Running copy in muted, 36 to 48ch measures. The base is 16px at 1.6.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav links, status lines, text links. Sentence case, never tracked uppercase.

caption.purpose: Figure captions, roles, schools. The proof strip uses 14px bold at 80% fg.

shadows.name: sheet-edge
shadows.purpose: Every sheet after the cover. Cast upward onto the sheet it covers.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: The nav pill after scrolling (--shadow-soft). Dark: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2), 0 8px 24px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5).

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The open mobile menu (--shadow-float). Dark: 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2), 0 24px 48px -20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.65).

shadows.name: device
shadows.purpose: The laptop lid. The phone uses 0.25 / 0 30px 60px -24px 0.55.

shadows.name: amber-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons at rest. Hover: 0 10px 22px -8px rgb(255 164 49 / 0.8).

shadows.name: card-on-band
shadows.purpose: The contact form card on the petroleum band.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: UI state transitions at 200 to 300ms (buttons, links, fields).

motion.name: inertial-scroll
motion.value: Lenis duration 1.1s, easing 1 - (1 - t)^4, anchor offset -16px
motion.purpose: Page scroll. Not started under reduced motion.

motion.name: sheet-recede
motion.purpose: A sheet sticks at min(0, viewport height − sheet height) while the next one covers it. Progress runs from the next sheet's top entering the viewport to it reaching the top. Reduced motion: stacks without scale or dim.

motion.name: cover-depth
motion.value: copy -50px, lead photo -90 / block -40, second photo -170 / block -110; pointer spring stiffness 80 damping 18, far x10, near x-18
motion.purpose: Cover layers drift at separate rates while it is covered. The pointer layer runs on fine pointers only.

motion.name: portrait-block-trail
motion.purpose: A creator's offset block trails its photo. Reduced motion: 0.

motion.name: depth-image
motion.purpose: Photos drift inside 20px frames. Reduced motion: held at -6.5%.

motion.name: word-reveal
motion.purpose: Manifesto statement. Reduced motion: full ink. The screen reader reads the intact sentence.

motion.name: trajectory-draw
motion.value: pathLength scrubbed from start 75% to end 92%, spring stiffness 120 damping 30
motion.purpose: A solid petroleum stroke draws over the dashed path. Reduced motion: fully drawn.

motion.name: device-tilt
motion.value: laptop rotateX 24deg -> 0, scale 0.9 -> 1 (perspective 1400px); phone y 38% -> 0, rotate 7deg -> 0
motion.purpose: The Academy scene settles flat at center screen while the phone climbs faster. Reduced motion: flat.

motion.name: drift-pairs
motion.purpose: Adjacent objects drift against each other. Reduced motion: 0.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Amber pill used for every primary action, with a warm glow and a 2px lift on hover.
components.html: Conoce nuestra historia
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--amber, #ffa431); color: var(--amber-ink, #3a2405); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5), 0 6px 16px -6px rgb(255 164 49 / 0.7); transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5), 0 10px 22px -8px rgb(255 164 49 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--cyan, #0d9ac5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Secondary action paired with a primary button. Its underline turns amber on hover.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; color: var(--fg, #062f3b); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 6px; text-decoration-color: var(--line, rgb(4 76 98 / 0.14)); transition: text-decoration-color 200ms; } .ds-text-link:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--amber, #ffa431); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--cyan, #0d9ac5); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Floating Nav
components.description: Pill nav floating 12px from the top. Shown here in its scrolled state: translucent paper with blur.
components.html:
Señas a Voces
  • El problema
  • Lo que construimos
  • Creadores
Escríbenos
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; height: 64px; padding: 0 8px 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface, #ffffff) 85%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line, rgb(4 76 98 / 0.14)), 0 1px 2px rgb(4 76 98 / 0.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgb(4 76 98 / 0.18); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: 'League Spartan', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; color: var(--petrol, #044c62); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-nav-links a { display: block; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg, #062f3b) 80%, transparent); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg, #062f3b) 5%, transparent); color: var(--fg, #062f3b); } .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible, .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--cyan, #0d9ac5); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--amber, #ffa431); color: var(--amber-ink, #3a2405); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5), 0 6px 16px -6px rgb(255 164 49 / 0.7); }

components.name: Sheet
components.description: One page of the portfolio. Cream with 22px corners, an upward edge shadow, wave lines in opposite corners and a headline-plus-intro header.
components.html:
El problema

Solo alrededor de 300,000 personas usan la Lengua de Señas Mexicana, y la mayoría oyente no la conoce.
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; overflow: clip; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--bg, #faf7ed); color: var(--fg, #062f3b); padding: 72px 48px 96px; box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 rgb(4 76 98 / 0.06), 0 -24px 48px -28px rgb(4 40 52 / 0.45); } .ds-sheet-wave { position: absolute; top: -72px; right: -88px; width: 260px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--cyan, #0d9ac5) 45%, transparent); pointer-events: none; } .ds-sheet-title { position: relative; margin: 0; font-family: 'League Spartan', 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(40px, 5.6vw, 80px); line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--petrol, #044c62); text-wrap: balance; } .ds-sheet-intro { position: relative; margin: 24px 0 0; max-width: 56ch; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(17px, 1.4vw, 20px); line-height: 1.65; color: var(--muted, #45646c); }

components.name: Portrait on Offset Block
components.description: A creator photo in a 20px frame over a flat block in that creator's tone, offset 16px. Used only for creators.
components.css: .ds-portrait { position: relative; width: 220px; margin: 0 16px 16px 0; } .ds-portrait-block { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform: translate(16px, 16px); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--tone); } .ds-portrait-photo { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; border-radius: 20px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #7a0d12, #e5484d); }

components.name: Press Clipping
components.description: A paper cutting on the desk: white, 10px corners, a hairline ring, a soft drop and a slight tilt.
components.html:
Expreso

“Estudiantes crean guante que traduce señas a voz”
components.css: .ds-clipping { max-width: 300px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); transform: rotate(-1.5deg); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line, rgb(4 76 98 / 0.14)), 0 2px 4px rgb(4 40 52 / 0.06), 0 18px 36px -20px rgb(4 40 52 / 0.35); } .ds-clipping-outlet { margin: 0; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--petrol, #044c62); } .ds-clipping-head { margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: 'League Spartan', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 700; color: var(--fg, #062f3b); }

components.name: Milestone Node
components.description: Trajectory stop: a 20px cyan node ringed in cream, a pale-cyan title chip and a cream-backed detail line.
components.html: Copa EnactusRepresentación de México en Puerto Rico.
components.css: .ds-milestone { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; text-align: center; background: var(--bg, #faf7ed); padding: 16px; } .ds-milestone-node { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--cyan, #0d9ac5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--bg, #faf7ed); } .ds-milestone-label { display: inline-block; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 10px; background: #d9eef4; font-family: 'League Spartan', sans-serif; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; color: var(--petrol, #044c62); } .ds-milestone-detail { max-width: 30ch; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg, #faf7ed); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted, #45646c); }

components.name: Featured Quote (Band)
components.description: The community's featured testimonial on petroleum, with an amber quote mark.
components.css: .ds-quote-band { margin: 0; max-width: 420px; padding: 40px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--band, #044c62); color: var(--band-fg, #eef7f8); } .ds-quote-mark { width: 36px; height: 28px; fill: var(--amber, #ffa431); } .ds-quote-band blockquote { margin: 24px 0 0; font-family: 'League Spartan', sans-serif; font-size: clamp(22px, 2vw, 28px); line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; } .ds-quote-band figcaption { margin-top: 32px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-quote-band figcaption b { display: block; } .ds-quote-band figcaption span { display: block; font-size: 14px; color: var(--band-muted, #b5d3da); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Cream field with a hairline ring and the label above. On focus the ring becomes 2px cyan.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--fg, #062f3b); } .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; padding: 14px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg, #faf7ed); color: var(--fg, #062f3b); font: inherit; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; caret-color: var(--cyan, #0d9ac5); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line, rgb(4 76 98 / 0.14)); transition: box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #45646c); } .ds-field:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--cyan, #0d9ac5); }

narrative.northStar: The Portfolio That Turns Its Own Pages
narrative.overview:
The site is the team's evidence portfolio, bound and paged. Every chapter is a cream sheet (22px corners) lying on a deeper sand desk. A sheet scrolls normally until its bottom edge reaches the viewport, then sticks there and recedes slightly as the next sheet slides over it. Depth comes from paper stacking and scroll-linked parallax. There are no fade-up entrances and nothing reveals itself on a timer. The portfolio cover's concentric cyan wave lines sit in two opposite corners of every sheet. That is how the brand repeats from page to page.

Petroleum carries the voice: League Spartan titles, set heavy and tight. Cyan appears at display size, in the wave lines and as the data and trajectory marks. Amber is reserved for actions and small markers. Body text is Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, a face built for legibility, because the audience includes deaf and hard-of-hearing readers and accessibility-focused institutions. Imagery is real: the four creators photographed under colored light, each on an offset block in their own color, plus real devices running real screen recordings of the platform.

The density is editorial. Wide sheets carry generous vertical breaks between chapters (up to 160px). Any section can hold asymmetric two-column compositions. The deliberate dark moment is the petroleum contact sheet that closes the stack, along with one band-colored featured quote.
keyCharacteristics: Paged sheets with 22px corners on a sand desk. Each sheet sticks at its bottom edge and recedes to 0.94 scale, dimming toward the desk, as the next sheet covers it.
Petroleum League Spartan display type (700, -0.02em, line-height 0.92 to 1.02). Cyan is used only for the second line of the cover headline and for marks.
Amber pill actions with a warm amber glow. Amber dots mark status and proof.
Concentric cyan wave lines in opposite sheet corners at 45% and 35% opacity.
Creator portraits sit on per-person colored offset blocks, and the block drifts on a different parallax rate from the photo.

Motion is scroll-linked depth only: Lenis inertial scroll, parallax, a word reveal, the trajectory drawing itself and device tilt. When reduced motion is on, all of it goes still and the stacking layout stays.

rules.name: The Paper, Not Gray Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is a warm sand/cream or a petroleum-tinted ink. Even the receding-sheet dim is the desk color at up to 55% opacity, never black or gray.

rules.name: The Amber Means Act Rule
rules.body: Amber fills only things you can press, plus tiny dots that mark status or proof. It never fills a card or a band.

rules.name: The No-Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case in bold Atkinson. The system has no tracked-out uppercase small labels and no kickers above titles. A sheet's title is the first thing on the sheet.

rules.name: The Cyan Is Display-Size Rule
rules.body: Cyan text appears only at display or figure size. Running text stays in fg or muted.

rules.name: The Recede, Don't Fade Rule
rules.body: A covered sheet scales from 1 to 0.94 (origin at the bottom center) while a desk-colored overlay rises from 0 to 0.55. Nothing else in the system fades in or out on entrance.

rules.name: The Shadow Points Up Rule
rules.body: Sheet shadows use a negative y offset because the newer page lies on top. Never drop a sheet shadow downward.

dos: Do build every new chapter as a sheet: 22px corners, the upward sheet-edge shadow, wave lines in opposite corners, and a headline-plus-intro header.
Do set titles in petroleum League Spartan 700 at -0.02em. Keep running text in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, at 17px with 1.65 leading, in muted, within 36 to 56ch.
Do fill actions with amber and amber-ink in full pills that are at least 48px tall, and pair a primary button with an underlined text link rather than a second filled button.
Do express depth through scroll-linked motion (stacking, parallax and drawn paths), and give every motion value a reduced-motion value of 0 or its resting state.
Do show real people, real devices and real platform recordings. Put creators on their own tone's offset block.
Do tint shadows with petroleum and keep the neutrals warm sand and cream.
donts: Don't add fade-up or slide-in entrance animations to sections or cards. Motion here is tied to scroll position, never triggered on entry.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a sheet title, or use tracked uppercase small labels.
Don't set body copy or small labels in cyan. It reaches only large-text contrast on cream.
Don't fill cards, bands or large areas with amber.
Don't use gray or black for the receding-sheet dim or as a neutral surface. Recede toward the desk.
Don't use colored offset blocks anywhere except behind creator portraits, and don't use them as a generic card shadow.
Don't introduce purple SaaS gradients, emoji feature cards or a row of three equal cards.
